\section{Profile}
PhD researcher in corporate governance and technology management, with expertise in machine learning, survival analysis, and panel data econometrics. Doctoral research investigates the timing and dynamics of Chief Technology Officer appointments, contributing to upper echelons theory and strategic leadership literature. Three years of university teaching experience with 400+ students taught and 20+ MSc dissertations supervised. Published in the \textit{International Journal of Finance \& Economics} . Over five years of professional experience in financial policy analysis at the People's Bank of China.
